# neighbor_coherence { #dyf.neighbor_coherence }

```python
neighbor_coherence(embeddings, knn_indices, sample_k=None)
```

Measure how coherent each point's neighborhood is.

For each point, computes mean pairwise cosine similarity among its
k nearest neighbors.  Topical documents have coherent neighborhoods
(neighbors are similar to each other).  Meta/structural documents
— date pages, event lists, disambiguation pages — pull in diverse
neighbors that have little in common, producing low coherence.

This is a general embedding-space signal that does not depend on
titles, metadata, or domain-specific heuristics.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type   | Description                                                                                                   | Default    |
|-------------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| embeddings  |        | (n, d) array of embedding vectors.                                                                            | _required_ |
| knn_indices |        | (n, k) array of neighbor indices per point          (as returned by sklearn NearestNeighbors, self excluded). | _required_ |
| sample_k    |        | If set, use only the first sample_k neighbors for the       pairwise calculation (faster for large k).        | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                     | Description                                                      |
|--------|------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) | Float array of length n.  Each value is the mean pairwise cosine |
|        | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) | similarity among that point's neighbors.  Range roughly [0, 1];  |
|        | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) | higher values indicate meta/structural content (echo chambers of |
|        | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) | structurally similar documents).                                 |
